rationale: The complete native compiler analysis is correct but takes 116 seconds on the admitted 100,000-file fixture. The fixed 60-second graph-analysis allowance loses all call edges. Test a bounded five-minute allowance for background projection; capture_bounded continues to apply any shorter request deadline. This is a coverage/correctness candidate, not a speedup claim. No file/call is omitted.

readiness.qualified_scope: Ten equal-size synthetic repositories with one million initial files, generated local-call correctness, bounded context behavior, cross-project bindings, citations, budgets, repeatability, revocation and exporter changes.
remaining_limits: Every main graph-enabled workspace context reports 600,000 omitted documents.
Workspace context medians are 31.8–32.1 seconds without cross-repository retrieval and 42.8–44.2 seconds with it; peak RSS reaches 15.82 GiB.
One exporter edit needs 132.8 seconds of admission and 349.5 seconds for its graph refresh.
Combined large reviewed-memory/source scale, uneven million-file layouts, concurrency, warm-server latency and independent user quality remain unqualified.
